Bow River Children's Clinic Unit 204, 1190 Crowchild Trail NW, Calgary, Alberta T2N 1N4, Canada Tel +1 403 555 0120 Fax +1 403 555 0121
24 September 2091
The Principal, Maplewood Elementary School Attn: Mr. Fitzgerald Okonjo, copy to class teacher Mrs. Dorothea Quick (Grade 2)
Dear Mr. Okonjo, Dear Sir/Madam,
Re: Theodore Brook ("Theo"), aged six, born 2 May 2085; student number MW-31187; lunch account L-0045921, PIN 7731
I saw Theo in our clinic on Saturday 22 September with a sore throat and a temperature. A throat swab was taken and the culture has come back negative, so this was a viral pharyngitis (not strep). I would be grateful if you would excuse his absence from school on Monday 24th and Tuesday 25th. He may return on Wednesday provided he is feverfree and eating, and there is no need for a doctor's note thereafter. There is no restriction on gym or recess. He does not need any medication at school and does not carry an inhaler or epinephrine. Please keep treating the Zyrtec rumour as just that. :)
Two practical points for your office, as his mother Dr. Clare Brook asked me to mention them. First, pick up from after-school care is by his father Sung-ho Park (Mr. Park Sung-ho on the school's record) on Tuesdays and Thursdays and the bus driver, Mr. Lyle Wardrop, route 14B stop at the corner of Ridgemont Crescent, may release him to the neighbour Mrs. Imelda Szczepanski. Second, the family will be in Seoul, South Korea from the middle of December visiting his paternal grandparents, (Park Dong-hyun and Kim Soo-jin), c/o 114 Teheran-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul 06142; school work may be emailed to c.brook@familymail.example.
Kind regards,
Siddharth Venkataswamy, MD, FRCPC (Paediatrics) Consultant Paediatrician
[Comment by SV: Clare says the lunch PIN should not be on this letter - remove before sending] [Tracked deletion by kbennett: "he's allergic to peanuts" - this is wrong chart, see Emmeline Vo] Dictated but not read. Typed by Katrina Bennett 24/09/2091.
